assembly_notes: Benchtop laboratory centrifuge. The grounded `housing` part is a CadQuery body with a real recessed rotor well, a drive boss on the well floor bored for the rotor shaft, a moulded well rim and a front control panel. The `rotor` turns CONTINUOUS about +z on that boss and carries tube_holder_count holders on one derived circle; the well radius is the rotor radius plus a running gap, so the swept envelope never touches the wall. The `lid` closes over the rim and either swings REVOLUTE on a rear hinge line, slides PRISMATIC back on side rails, or lifts PRISMATIC straight up between two guide posts; either way it clears the tallest holder by a real gap when shut, and the rails or hinge knuckles keep it in contact with the housing at every pose. housing_form varies the body (lofted benchtop shell, the same shell on a continuous moulded plinth, squared clinical cabinet, compact microfuge) and each derives the same well datum. rotor_form varies the holders between drilled fixed-angle wells and hung swing-bucket carriers. rotor_radius_m, body_height_m and holder_depth_m are honest continuous parameters deriving the well, boss, holder circle, rotor height and lid clearance; palette and panel graphics are non-core. panel_control puts one real front control on the housing: a pivoting latch lever on its own REVOLUTE shaft, or a momentary push button on a short PRISMATIC travel into its recess.
